training: One symmetric pair of policy perturbations. Each plays both physical seats on the training map against the full original Master3s2. Only final U, win/draw/loss and official margin may influence fitting. Archive all four games, including ties and extinction.
development: After fitting and freezing the candidate, play unchanged parent and candidate in both seats of this second map. Do not reuse these outcomes for training. If the estimator makes no change, record the null update explicitly and skip identical duplicated arms.
map_checks: Neither map can be used in the independent 100-map exam. Clear the two seeds and initial terrains against studied/training/development sources before collection. Retire ineligible draws before playing.
